title: Playboy Magazine December 1988 Gala Christmas Bonanza Norman Mailer
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, December 1988 issue -- Gala Christmas Bonanza! Featuring the 1988 Playmate Review ("Our Devastating Dozen"), plus Norman Mailer on mistresses, Cher's interview, Pete Hamill, Jimmy Breslin, Harlan Ellison on comics, and Leroy Neiman.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage -- small crease at the lower-left cover corner, please review photos carefully for exact condition.
